sourceContext: Costa Clean App ChatGPT Project - final authorized-commit and point-of-use integrity repair for PR #21
objective: Correct exclusively the two current PR #21 P1 findings by anchoring integrity checks to the immutable authorized commit and validating every file-backed executable stage at its point of use.
why: Automated review identified that later checks re-resolve mutable HEAD instead of the authorized commit captured during authorization, and file-backed executable stages can consume working-tree bytes after a global precheck without immediate revalidation.
outOfScope: UI, database schema, migrations, authentication, billing, DNS, email, payments, secrets, or production operations.
GitHub application branch push, pull request mutation, merge, auto-merge, or deployment.
Unrelated refactor, test weakening, global timeout increase, or test skipping.
Changing the authorized commit after authorization.
Executing any file-backed stage without point-of-use validation against the authorized commit.
acceptanceCriteria: Published command scope derives to exactly the six allowed files.
The same persistent Costa Clean Codex thread is reused with at most one fresh Executor turn and no Planner turn.
The certified combined six-file repair is preserved.
Regression tests reproduce and reject assume-unchanged, skip-worktree, direct committed-vs-working-tree divergence, and manifest divergence.
The package manifest and all 17 expected package artifacts are protected by an authorization integrity boundary.
planV6(), preflightV6(), and the execution path enforce committed-state integrity; execution re-checks immediately before the first QA write.
No QA or remote write occurs on integrity failure.
Coherent working-tree identity semantics remain intact and no mixed identity source is reintroduced.
Targeted tests, full tests, lint, typecheck, and build pass.
No source publication, PR mutation, merge, deploy, Supabase mutation, or production mutation occurs.
The applied migration supabase/migrations/20260728160000_portal_reviewed_change_contract.sql is protected as an immutable committed artifact.
Protected-byte authorization reads only HEAD:path or the authorized committed tree and never the mutable index.
A new-head automated review reports zero P0/P1 findings before PR #20 is retired.
The authorized commit SHA is captured from the authorization state and propagated immutably through execution.
All protected-byte checks use authorizedCommit:path and never HEAD:path or :path after authorization.
Every file-backed executable and recovery stage revalidates the exact file immediately before use.
HEAD movement and all required TOCTOU regressions fail closed with zero unauthorized execution calls.
requiredApprovals: github remote write outside control results
stopConditions: Project identity, accepted Brain, command hash, canonical baseline, active thread, or worktree binding mismatch.
Command scope does not derive exactly six paths.
A second active project thread or any new thread is created.
More than one real Codex Executor turn or any Planner turn occurs.
Seed blob mismatch, seventh functional file, or drift in either immutable ops file.
Hidden Git index state or committed-vs-working-tree divergence can pass.
Plan, preflight, or execution integrity boundary is missing or execution is not rechecked before the first write.
Any QA write occurs before integrity failure.
Manifest structural contract changes outside derived identities.
Targeted tests, full tests, lint, typecheck, or build fail.
Publisher worktree diverges or PR #20 changes.
Source is pushed or any unauthorized remote/production mutation occurs.
The applied migration is not protected or any authorization path reads the mutable index.
Authorized HEAD changes after capture or any later check rebinds to mutable HEAD.
Any file-backed executable or recovery stage lacks point-of-use validation.
verificationRequirements: Verify project identity, accepted Brain, and canonical baseline before dispatch.
Verify exactly six allowed file paths and one active persistent thread.
Seed and verify the six certified combined source blobs from da2cef29b971cd49e2972d6abd9bfeacb9911668.
Empirically test assume-unchanged and skip-worktree detection on the executor platform.
Compare each protected working-tree Git blob to HEAD:path, including the manifest and all 17 artifacts.
Verify plan, preflight, and execution-time integrity gates and zero QA writes on rejection.
Verify the two immutable ops files remain byte-identical.
Run targeted P1 regressions, full tests, lint, typecheck, and build.
Bind all report and result evidence to project, command, Brain, run, task, baseline, and execution worktree.
Verify no Costa Clean source push, PR mutation, merge, deploy, Supabase mutation, or production mutation.
Verify the applied migration is included in the protected path set with its certified baseline SHA-256.
Verify every protected byte is read from HEAD:path or an authorized committed tree and no git rev-parse :path authorization remains.
Capture and propagate the immutable authorized commit SHA from authorization state.
Test HEAD movement from authorized commit A to B and reject execution.
Test mutations between global verification and each file-backed stage, including migration, postcheck, matrix, fixture, concurrency, digest, cleanup, and rollback.
